hero.title: Maja Labo Dahu
hero.desc: The noble philosophy guiding the people of Bima. This website is designed as an interactive digital gateway to explore the rich culture of Bima.

items.title: Masa Naka Era
items.desc: The prehistoric era and formation of early communities (Ncuhi) who led territories across the Mbojo land before any centralized kingdom.

items.title: Kingdom of Bima
items.desc: The establishment of a monarchy influenced by Hindu culture, becoming one of the important maritime powers in eastern Nusantara.

items.title: Sultanate of Bima
items.desc: Transition to an Islamic Sultanate in the early 17th century (Sultan Abdul Kahir I), bringing major changes to law, arts, and culture.

items.title: Modern Bima
items.desc: Integration with the Republic of Indonesia. The sultanate's legacy is now preserved through Museum Asi Mbojo and community traditions.

footer.title: Let's Preserve Together
footer.desc: Be part of the journey to preserve and promote the splendor of Bima's culture to the world.
